title: Incorrect dunder method check in ChainableUndefined
detail: The condition mistakenly raises AttributeError for attribute names that end with double underscores but do not start with them, e.g., '__setstate__' will not raise, causing copy.deepcopy to fail with an Undefined object instead of AttributeError.
note: Names the planted check as inverted; its example is muddled.

title: Generator may leak if it yields nothing
detail: When the generator yields no values, the loop body never executes, so the generator is never closed. This can leak resources or keep the generator alive longer than intended.

title: Incorrect __Host- prefix validation logic
detail: The function returns False for any cookie whose name starts with "__host-" because of the negated check, but the intended logic is to reject such cookies when they do not satisfy the domain and path requirements. This inverted condition causes valid __Host- cookies to be incorrectly accepted and invalid ones to be incorrectly rejected.
note: Says __Host- cookies are now always rejected, which the planted `and` does.

title: Incorrect raw mode detection for short options
detail: The helper treats any short option containing the letter 'r' (e.g., '-R') as a request to disable raw mode, returning False. This incorrectly prevents raw mode when the user passes '-R', which should enable raw control characters.
note: Describes the planted inversion for short flags like -R.
